fields.acceptance: A testscript ships a change set opened in the main checkout (run start --new or change new) and merges its PR. ship close-out exits 0 with main_updated true, the main checkout's HEAD is origin/main, and its log entries are tracked. A second case gives the main checkout an untracked .rhiza/log file whose bytes differ from the merged one: close-out exits 1, update-main is failed, and the file is unchanged
fields.statement: Before ship close-out fast-forwards the main checkout, it removes the untracked .rhiza/log files there that the incoming origin/main holds byte for byte, so a merged change set whose first entries were opened in the main checkout updates main. Untracked files that differ or that main lacks stay, and update-main fails and names them as it does now

fields.acceptance: A testscript runs ship close-out --forget while the main checkout has uncommitted tracked changes: it exits 1, update-main is failed, and .git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json still exists. After the changes are discarded, the same close-out --forget exits 0 with main_updated true and the ship state file is gone
fields.statement: ship close-out --forget deletes the change set's ship state only after update-main succeeds, so a close-out whose pull failed keeps its state and finishes when retried
